tidbit: Did you know… about 8,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Nvidia's role as an artificial intelligence financier faces its first major test as neoclouds take a market hit, reported by CNBC.
Ontario voters are turning to artificial intelligence chatbots for 2026 municipal election information, confirmed by the Winnipeg Free Press, raising concerns over accuracy and reliability.
Anthropic has partnered with British private equity firm Hg to launch a consultancy arm, reported by City AM, to boost revenue and momentum toward an initial public offering.
OpenAI has launched Dots, a new artificial intelligence assistant for enterprises that automates tasks across 4,000 apps, reported by BornCity.
OpenAI is training top artificial intelligence models offline after security breaches, confirmed by RP Online, having resumed training on October 1st after an 11-day pause.
Free every hour.
